coach_labels: The entire body isn't rotating; you're only using the strength of your arms. Both shoulders are too tense. Your body's center of gravity isn't balanced between your feet. When throwing punches, be careful not to lock your front leg straight.
When returning your punch, keep your rear hand close.
Your arms are too stiff; make sure to use your lower body strength.
